hook: Their boat caught fire off South Carolina. In December.
narration: Four people were aboard when this boat caught fire, in December.
It burned off Murrells Inlet, just south of Myrtle Beach, South Carolina.
A good Samaritan boat came to help, and a Coast Guard helicopter crew flew in overhead.
First they lowered the rescue swimmer onto the pitching deck.
The swimmer rides the cable down so someone can steady the basket and help the survivor climb in.
One of the four was showing signs of hypothermia.
So the crew sent the basket down to the boat. [short pause] Then it came back up with the survivor inside.
outcome: All four were rescued, and the survivor with hypothermia was flown out by the helicopter crew.
title: Boat on fire off South Carolina, 4 aboard
description:
A boat caught fire off Murrells Inlet, south of Myrtle Beach, South Carolina, on Dec. 14, 2014. The Coast Guard and a good Samaritan rescued all four people aboard, and one was medevaced with symptoms of hypothermia.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video, Air Station Savannah, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/381631/coast-guard-good-samaritan-rescue-4-boat-fire
